It can come in an unruly air
Uncontrolled rain, tear
It can come in a falling petal

दौरे माज़ी का वो हमनवा चाहिये

My caretaker in life

The different stories of life
She has seen life in delicate dreams

allow me to look back...

A gust of hope it is,
Sweeps away the mist of despair every time.

you need not discard
all that you cannot believe

And I listen to the unsaid words they try to speak

Dicy guffaws
Cuddling dusk and dawn.

No one shall be repeated and no dynasty be followed

179.text:

At the threshold of exit life beckons life.

Wait longingly
To have that divine Touch

182.text:
Under the canopy of clouds
Cuddled by warm winds,
Whispering songs of birds.

so, silence blows with the wind
over the arid desert
shifting shapes of sand dunes...

Blooming jasmines smile everywhere.

The learned ones

Like a fountain of new generation.

Now

Alone but not lonely.

To love, believe and live.

As I look back,
I see the years went by
when you were simply the breathe I inhaled a little further away from my body.

382.text: The early sun probes the solitary leaf with a kiss

383.text:
Afar, flowers bloom
in a field of wounds.

384.text:
While searching for the peace in beauty
A half span of life swings behind the curtain
Half-life line is limping for birth`s pertinent

385.text:
Abandoned by big cruel world cold
bewildered orphans of wars unfold
soundless shrieks tearlessly mourn
yearning mom who with hope is gone

386.text:
You have designed my fate
to scare away birds,
at least now send your bull to eat me all
except the skull.

387.text:
आज हैं यहाँ,शायद कल नहीं होंगे।
जगमगाते हुए नए चेहरे सजे होंगे।

388.text:
ତତେ ହୁଏତ ଜଣାନାହିଁ ସେ କାରଣ,
ତୁ ତ ଦେଖି ପାରୁନା
କେଉଁ ନିଆଁଝାସରେ କବଳିତ ମୋର ମନ ତପୋବନ !

389.text:
The ocean melts inside the mirror,
The red fish backstrokes in the sea.

390.text:
My life sails
Pass by, the days, months and years
Who keeps their records?

391.text:
The curious onlookers came in hordes,
and wanted to know whose body it was.
The man looked like a padre, a mulla and a priest.

392.text:
They are horrified to witness the dark, unmasking itself,
Shedding the blood of terror, the suspensive silence dwells.

393.text:
Useless all without you
Earth, Heaven and Life ,
I care none ,I desire none

394.text:
Like this waterfall my dream will keep flowing in my veins,
I won`t stop until the day comes that I achieve my dream.

395.text:
It doesn`t matter though,
You,
Who are the cause of motion in me—
Tearful greetings.

396.text:
They are all magnificent creatures in their own unique way
Created by the Master of the Universe!

398.text:
Sometimes, it means I write.
Sometimes, it means I think.

399.text:
But when I came out of their sadness and delight
To live and love my own pain, I learnt how to write.

400.text:
There is a sorrow in me that grows,
swells like the belly of a pregnant woman.

401.text:
And so, every spring,
she writes to the sky,
knowing even letters wear flowers.

402.text:
ଥରୁଟେ ହାତ ଟେକିଦେଲେ
ଏ ବିଶ୍ୱ ଭୋଗନ୍ତାନି ଜୀବନହୀନ
ପୃଥିବୀର ଏ ଖାଁ ଖାଁ ଅସୀମ ଶୂନ୍ୟତା |.

403.text:
Emerges pure from the womb of snow
And mixes with dirt
But stops not.

404.text:
I am simply numb in my speech
Singing your glory as ever.

405.text:
Let me live like a Prince
And die like a phoenix
To return to life again
From my own ashes.

406.text:
ଆଲୋକ ଓ ପବନ କେମିତି ନିର୍ଭୟରେ
ଅନ୍ଧାର କେମିତି ଜଡସଡ ହେଇ
ବୁଲନ୍ତି ବଗିଚାରେ?

407.text: And it allows no external judge to dictate one`s life paths anymore.

408.text:
Hearts mix and match well
Like colours in rainbow light
Love flows pure and true

409.text:
ଏଇ ଅପୂରଣୀୟ ଶୂନ୍ୟସ୍ଥାନମାନେ ହିଁ
ମୋତେ ପାଶ୍ କରେଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତି ଅନାୟାସରେ
ମୋ ଜଟିଳ ଜୀବନ ପରୀକ୍ଷାରେ!

410.text:
रख लिया विक्षोभ बहुत,
अब समर्पण भाव रखूंगी।
रुक्मण का अधिकार नहीं,
राधा सा प्रीत लगाव रखूंगी।

411.text:
The poems I wrote with pieces of you
Do they still echo in your heart
or have you muted every memory too?

412.text: କୁହ, ଉପେକ୍ଷାର ସେ ରଡ଼ନିଆଁରେ କେବେ ଜଳିଚ?

413.text:
ବାପା କୁହନ୍ତି ତୁମଠି ଅଗାଧ ଜ୍ଞାନ
ଅଥଚ ମୁଁ ଭାବେ କେମିତିକା କେଜାଣି
ଯିଏ ଆଜିଯାଏଁ ପଢିପାରଲାନି
ଗୋଟେ ଅବୋଧ ପ୍ରେମିକର ମନ ...!

414.text:
ଏବେ ଜଡ଼ତା ଛାଡ଼ି ଜାଗ୍ରତ ହୁଅ
ଇତିହାସର ଆଖିରେ ଆଖି ମିଳେଇ
ତମକୁ ଜବାବ୍‌ ଦେବାକୁ ହେବ
ସେଇ ନିଃର୍ବସ୍ତ୍ର ନାରୀଙ୍କ ଅଶ୍ରୁ ଅନଳର !

415.text:
As I put the kettle on the stove,
Unexpectedly, spring bloomed.

416.text:
नए रंगो में भरते हुए
फिर से तुममें अपनी कहानी
लिखूँगा ।

417.text:
I bled for beauty, gave my bones to light,
only to find myself lost,
in love with the loss.

418.text:
People lie and waste away,
As if they never had been!

419.text:
It will follow the sun
with the same shadows as yesterday.

420.text:
Yet, it is me who gives light to you all.
Nurtures you. Now I have left for me no more.

421.text:
ନଈର  ଛାତିରେ ଛାତିଏ ପାଣି
ପାଣିରେ ସର୍ଫରୀଂକ  ନୃତ୍ୟ ସହ
ଚିକ ମିକ ଜହ୍ନର ଜ୍ଯୋତ୍ସ୍ନା ।

422.text:
ସମୁଦାୟ ତଫ ପଡ଼ା ପାଞ୍ଚଟି
ସବୁତିକ ତୁମକୁ ଦେଇଦେଲେ
ମୁଁ ରହିବି କୋଉଠି?

423.text: The sun is shining brightly today, things exist.

424.text:
ତ୍ରିରଙ୍ଗା ଉଡ଼ାଇ, କରତାଳି ଦେଇ,ଜନଗଣମନ ଗାଇ,
ପ୍ରମାଣିତ କରିସାରିଥିଲି ମୋର ଦେଶପ୍ରେମ।
ତଥାପି ଦେଶ କଥା ଯାହା ବାକିରହିଗଲା,
ଛଳଛଳ ହେଉଥିଲା ଏକ ନିରୀହ କିଶୋର ଆଖିରେ।

425.text: Seems like a death with the heart still beating.

426.text:
My yesterdays lay
soaked in cheap perfume
and salty memories

427.text:
The ship sails on.
Life is an exploration.

428.text:
I`m the last daughter
Of this legacy,
Who refused to stay in fantasy.

429.text:
People have dug into the heart of the earth,
Searching for gold, diamond, coal, and petrol,
Leading to more threats in earthquakes.

430.text:
स्त्री एक किताब है
जिसका हर पाठ
नई कहानी बोलेगा
अपने समय का भेद खोलेगा

431.text:
She searches herself in him,
he in her, only the two can join.
Thoughts on wings, words mute.
Hearts swing, oneness they feel.

432.text:
ଅସହାୟତାର ଆଖିରୁ
ଦିଶିଯିବ କାଳେ ଲୁହ ବୋଲି
କଡାରୁ କଡା ତାଗିଦ କରୁଥାନ୍ତି ।
ସେତିକି ପ୍ରଗାଢ କରୁଥାନ୍ତି ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ବାସ ।

433.text:
I write because silence gnaws the walls.
The words come like insects—
they know where the wounds are.

434.text: The gloves of the stolen childhood

435.text:
I had only one
Answer for them
I am a man a Human.

436.text:
I soak my heart in brine,
In all that sunshine.
Like sipping a fine
Bottle of red wine.

437.text: Dreams in the eyes are like flowers;

438.text:
With their motherly nurture,
With their loverly compassion.

439.text:
Some said he lost his dreams
And transmuted into a moth to the flame.

440.text:
None cares to think
Of the felled oaks
Incapable of inviting
Rain anymore!

441.text:
ମୋ ଆନ୍ଚୁଡା ଗାଲ
ଏ ସବୁ ପାଦ ଚିହ୍ନ ମୋ ଜୀବନର
ମୋ ପାପ ଅବା ପୁଣ୍ୟ ର ..

442.text:
On the either side of my path
Time spreads like a blue sky overhead,
Time spreads like green fields below.

443.text:
Even if I hesitate and quiver,
My fear means nothing—I love Heaven more.
Yes, my friends, we`ll gather at the Rivers.

444.text:
The sun bid adieu
The Elysian in its gerua attire
the day gradually began to cease
the trees, like monks, whispered silent sermons.

445.text:
ସାବଜା ଦୁବଘାସ ତଳେ
ମୁଁ ମେଲି ଧରିଲା ବେଳେ ହଳଦିଆ ସୂତା କାନି ମୋର
ତମେ ଗଣ୍ଠି ପଡ଼ିଥିଲ କାହା ରେଶମୀ ପଣତ ରେ !

446.text:
Trust me i`ve aligned me well
Am busy mending injured emotions
Your wrapped whispers matter, baby !

447.text:
You turned to be a love now.
You have given me big canvas.
I will paint my life.

448.text:
Little dazzling waves appear
Embrace the shore
With a sprightly dance
They seem to be near ones.

449.text:
क्यूंकि डर के आगे ही नहीं , विश्वास के साथ से भी जीत हैं ,
और उम्मीद पर तो दुनिया कायम हैं।

450.text:
କେଉଁ ଚିଠିର ମୋହ
ଆବୋରି ରଖିଛି ମତେ
ଆଜନ୍ମ ଏଯାବତ୍ !

451.text:
ମୁଁ ହସିଲି
ଉତ୍ତର ଦେଲି : ଅଂଧାରରେ ହୁଏତ
ଭୂତ ,ଚୋର ବା ସାପ
ଆଲୁଅରେ ତ ଅନେକ କ୍ଷତର ଭିଡ଼ !

452.text:
Tearful eyes
cloudy sky
wind laments
drizzles cry.

453.text:
ସକାଳ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟର କଅଁଳ କିରଣରେ
ଆଙ୍କିଦିଏ ଚୁମାଟିଏ
ମୋ ନୀରବିତ ନିଶ୍ଚୁପ ସମୟର
ଉପନୀତ ଉପବନରେ  ।

454.text:
If you were a person
What would you do
With all of you
Belonging to you?

455.text:
Drawing the line of  partition while the river was flowing
Water bubbles burst with laughter.

456.text:
Torrential rain enlightens me about
the bygone of care. Bareness, punctuated
with fine, black threads, weave a design of desire.

457.text:
And when the final evening falls, and earthly songs grow faint
and few, Love will remain—a timeless light, forever finding its
way to you.

458.text:
I glanced at the window despondently,
Weary were my thoughts, wearier my body,

459.text:
ଶବ୍ଦ ମାନେ ଭାବନାଠୁ ଅନେକ ଦୂରରେ
କେବଳ ତୁମକୁ ପାଇବାର ଉତ୍ତର।

460.text:
You can feel it,
settling in your chest,
but you don`t say a word.

461.text:
The earth the sky and the water base
Will breathe in peace

462.text:
ଏଇ  ଯେଉଁ ସମାଜ
ପ୍ରେମକୁ ପାପ ବୋଲି କହୁଛନ୍ତି
କହୁଛନ୍ତି ପ୍ରେମ କିଛି ନୁହେଁ
ସବୁ ଦେହର ଖେଳ.....

463.text:
Let them go who never came
Who never stood by the river`s shore alone
Holding hands in silence

464.text:
Her frame—
Not resurrected, but reclaimed.
Not Eve seeking forgiveness, but Lilith
Walking away from paradise and into the unknown.

465.text:
‎Once it slips through your fingers,
‎You find remorse in your palm-
‎That is the power, and it is timeless.

466.text:
ବଲବଲ ହୋଇ ଚାହିଁରହେ ତାଙ୍କ ମୁହଁକୁ,
ପୁଣି ଆକାଶକୁ।
ଵନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯାଏ ଆଖି।

467.text:
In the end,
perhaps it`s hard to find one honest in love.

468.text:
ଘରଚଟିଆଙ୍କୁ ପଞ୍ଜୁରୀରେ ରଖି
ଶାଗୁଣାମାନେ
ତିଆରୁଛନ୍ତି ଆଣବିକ ବୋମା

469.text:
ପଛରେ ଛାଡି ଆସିଲି କେତେ କେତେ ପଙ୍କିଳ ପ୍ରାଚୀନତାକୁ,
ଛାଡି ଆସିଲି ସେଇ ଛାଇମାନଙ୍କୁ
ଯିଏ ମୋ ପାଦଚଲା ରାସ୍ତାର ମୂରବୀ ସାଜିଥିଲେ !

470.text:
All the while I wonder
who this self might be,
what purpose holds me here,
or why the great earth keeps turning.

471.text:
The bluish splendour of your eyes
Gives a rare feeling
Your smiling face
Gives an altogether different feeling.

472.text:
ତୁମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିମାନ
ଛୁଇଁ ଚାଲିଥାଆନ୍ତି
ମତେ
ପୁନର୍ଜନ୍ମ ଲଭେ ।।
